author: Gemini
description: Minimalist industrial tech: Matte grayscale structures with piercing neon data accents for extreme contrast and balanced readability.

design_notes.indicator_* (240-245) & emphasis_structu: Pure Grayscale - The UI chrome and icons are stripped of all color. Subtle grayscale variation on icons provides unique visual fingerprints without breaking the cold, matte industrial aesthetic.
design_notes.emphasis_primary (255): Absolute White - Maximum contrast for the most important data points against dark terminal backgrounds.
design_notes.active_cyan (51) & active_purple (135): Laser Neon - Pure, piercing cyan and purple for active tools and agents. Background is grayscale, so these pop without clashing.
design_notes.active_teal (50) & stable_blue (39): Bright Neon - High-intensity teal and blue accents for secondary activity and identity.
design_notes.stable_green (82) & completed_check (82): Acid Green - A sharp, high-tech yellow-green (ANSI 82) instead of a muted forest green, matching the cyberpunk/industrial tech vibe.
design_notes.active_amber (226) & alert_red (196): Warning Tape - High-visibility industrial yellow (226) and pure laser red (196) for warnings and critical alerts.
